Verified: `DateTime.fromISO("0099-12-31").plus({ day: 2 })` is 0100-01-02, `DateTime.fromISO("0100-01-02").minus({ day: 2 })` is 0099-12-31, and a sweep of plus/minus days over years 0–200 matches the reference.
